about: madar-menu: foodics::parse over Foodics console exports (each case's files, in the order passed), validate over bulk menus, and the replace sentence (replace_sentence, confirms_replace). Inputs are hand-written (crates/madar-menu/src/foodics/tests.rs); expected answers are this crate's, written by MADAR_REGENERATE_MENU_VECTORS=1 and reviewed by hand. A refusal or error is the expected value itself, as the browser build returns it.
